name: Rebel Duet
source:
A 30-year-old office worker with a [b]traumatic past[/b], the protagonist ([I]male or female[/I]) is nearly fired from their job and collapses from stress. They awake to find themselves in a strange environment, with a beautiful young woman standing before them. It is revealed that she is a succubus, and you have been summoned to this world to become her bodyguard...

Will you embrace a new life in this foreign, dangerous world, or search for a return to a familiar - but difficult - life back on Earth?

Bond with your succubus companion, encounter new foes and allies, and gradually evolve into a powerful spellsword.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角（[i]可选男性或女性[/i]）是一名背负着[b]创伤过往[/b]的30岁上班族，在险些被公司解雇后因不堪重负而昏倒。一觉醒来，主角发现自己身处陌生的环境，眼前还站着一位年轻貌美的女子。原来她竟是一名魅魔，而你则是被召唤到这个世界来担任她的贴身保镖…

你究竟会在这个陌生而危机四伏的异世界拥抱崭新的人生，还是设法重返地球，回到那段熟悉却又步履维艰的日常？

与你的魅魔同伴加深羁绊，邂逅新的强敌与盟友，一步步成长为实力强大的魔剑士吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676930/]Steam[/url]]
